shared_elements: large upright monolithic slab/figure carved in low relief
anthropomorphic head/upper region at top of the stone
relief animals or creatures in profile
schematic arms/limbs rendered in shallow relief on the body of the stone
justification: Both are tall upright monoliths carved in shallow relief with an anthropomorphic scheme: a head-like element at the top, a horizontal belt-like band across the middle, schematic arms and a prominent disc/circle on the body, with additional creatures rendered in profile relief. The biggest difference in depicted content is that A's imagery is largely abstract, symmetrical and body-integral (ears, mask, ornaments belonging to a single figure), whereas B carries a crowded narrative-like assembly of distinct zoomorphs (quadrupeds, birds, a small squatting figure) in stacked registers across the surface.
